items.claim: Steven Aspel uses a high pressure style that Pat will not be able to keep up with.
items.quote: I feel like he melts Guier Pat with that high pressure style that he brings. I don't feel like Pat will be able to keep up.

items.claim: Pat has talent but doesn't use it consistently.
items.quote: GM Pat has talent, but he just doesn't use it, man.

items.claim: Tai Miller has very sharp boxing fundamentals and fights effectively behind the jab.
items.quote: His boxing is very sharp and goes out there in the debut and makes easy work of Adam Fugit... Good boxing fundamentals. And the fighting behind the jab is just so underutilized in MMA.

items.claim: Tai Miller's takedown defense has not been tested a whole lot throughout his career.
items.quote: Now, got some questions about the takedown defense, right? Throughout his career, haven't seen it tested a whole lot, right?

items.claim: Tai Miller will have about a five-inch reach advantage over Billy Ray Goff.
items.quote: He's going to have a big reach advantage here, about five inch reach advantage.

items.claim: Billy Ray Goff lacks activity, with his DWCS finish happening almost four years ago.
items.quote: getting the finish almost four years ago on DWCS. He hasn't been that active, right?

items.claim: Billy Ray Goff possesses more one-shot power than Tai Miller.
items.quote: I will say that I think golf does hit a little bit harder though in terms of like the one shot power.

items.claim: Alexia Tyanara has power on the feet and walks forward throwing big power shots.
items.quote: She's got all the skills. She's got power on the feet. She's kind of just a marauder man, right? She's going to walk forward, throw big power shots
